title: RBAC Roles and Permissions Semantic Contract
description: Draft semantic contract for role and permission evaluation supporting authentication and request authorization. The first implementation slice covers static permission allow/deny, dynamic policy allow/deny, step-up/authentication-required denial, accessible UI denial, audit-query permission filtering, and tenant-boundary preservation.
aiGuidance: Permissions are semantic enforcement primitives. Do not replace permission checks with role-name resemblance during implementation extraction.

stateModel.description: First-slice authorization state is normalised as requested -> evaluated -> allowed, denied, authentication-required, or step-up-required. Role lifecycle administration remains outside this slice.

permissions.description: Permission semantics require a resolved actor permission, a matching enabled resource policy, or an explicit UMA grant. Missing permission, unmatched policy, disabled or invalid policy, unresolved token, and explicit policy denial fail closed.

contracts.description: The first-slice authorization contract contains a resource, scope, required permission, actor identity, actor roles, actor permissions, optional dynamic resource policies, and a typed allow/deny result.

validation.description: Permission evaluation validates requested resource/action against the authenticated actor context and fails closed on missing permission, denied dynamic policy, disabled policy, invalid policy, unresolved token, and missing contextual audit permission.

errorModel.description: Missing or insufficient permission yields denied authorization, not partial access or generated-report readiness. Dynamic policy denial returns forbidden, insufficient authentication returns step-up/authentication-required, and unavailable or unregistered dynamic provider paths may fall back only to the static permission backstop.

auditModel.description: First-slice audit semantics require contextual audit reads to be permission-filtered, tenant-scoped, resource-scoped, and secret-redacted. Broader privileged-access audit expansion remains deferred.

readinessModel.description: Readiness requires positive and negative authorization behaviours to be defined and later proven under an authorized proof-only substrate before implementation extraction can rely on this slice.

proof.description: Future proof must exercise static allow, static deny, dynamic policy allow, dynamic policy deny, missing policy fail-closed, step-up/authentication-required denial, accessible UI denial, audit permission filtering, and tenant-boundary preservation. No proof evidence is created by this semantic instance.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: UI permission gating renders an accessible forbidden state when the actor lacks the required permission and must not duplicate authentication semantics.
